Name: Wandering Spouses
Author: dandm1
Description:
Wandering Spouses gives your Stardew Valley spouse the freedom to roam the farm. No longer is your spouse stuck inside the farmhouse on days when they don't go to town. No longer will they magically teleport from the farmhouse to the bus stop. No longer will they spend all day standing on the porch staring wistfully out at fields they can never visit.

[b][i]Now in v1.7 personalised dialogue added for Maru, now has dialogue for all core marriage candidates.[/i][/b]

[center][youtube]Cy8K5TjWcF4[/youtube][/center][center]﻿[/center]With Wandering Spouses from 9am to 3pm most days your spouse has the ability to wander around the farm, checking on the animals, inspecting the crops, visiting the buildings and appreciating the farm's beauty spots. As they wander they can talk to the farmer about what they see and the beauty of the farm.

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
The key features of Wandering Spouses are:
[list]
[*]Spouses can wander the farm from 9am (midday on patio days, dusk for Krobus) on days when they are not going to town and it is not raining or snowing. They reenter the farmhouse between 3pm and 5pm.
[*]Spouses going to town will walk across the farm to get there and walk back across the farm on their way back. Spouses can leave through Cindersap Forest or the Backwoods if that is quicker or the path to the bus stop is blocked.
[*]Spouses will never destroy things on your farm; they will always find a path to walk around obstacles.
[*]Hundreds of individual dialogue lines for each core game marryable character discussing what they see on the farm. All other spouses, including spouses from mods, will use generic lines or their own outdoor dialogue.
[*]Compatible with custom NPCs and other mods including Immersive Spouses, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30319]ValleyTalk[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]Polyamory Sweet[/url]﻿.
[/list]
[size=5][b]Dialogue[/b][/size]
In this release of the mod in-character lines have been included for all standard marriage candidates while they are walking around the farm. Modded characters use parts of their default dialogue unless they have a personalised dialogue content pack.

[size=4][b]Content Packs[/b][/size]
The mod was intended as a base that dialogue authors can use to write immersive experiences for spouses around the farm. You are welcome to write better / different dialogue for the core Stardew characters and to make dialogue packs for other characters. I have written [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3660]an article with details of how the dialogue works[/url] that should give you most of the details you need and created a template mod (under 'Optional Files' in the files section) to get you started. You can modify the existing mod content pack, but it will be easier when you upgrade if you use the template to create an add-on pack. If you do come up with great lines please do share them with the community as your own mod.

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Simply download the mod and unzip it into your Mods folder. The next time you start Stardew your spouse will be free to roam. There are no dependencies beyond Stardew, SMAPI and Content Patcher.

The config.json configuration just contains three options for Wandering Spouses, which allow you to stop your spouse wandering in the afternoon on patio days, prevent them walking across the farm when going to town and to restrict their access to the backwoods.

To support translation users, where the dialogue has been updated to add new lines there is a folder with the original asset files in the content pack. You may want to use the original files for some characters for compatibility with translations that don't include the newer lines.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley - version 1.6
[*]SMAPI - tested with version 4.1
[*]Content Patcher - tested with version 2.6
[/list]
[size=4][b]Tested Compatible Mods[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30319]ValleyTalk[/url] - version 1.3 or later﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]Polyamory Sweet[/url]﻿ - tested with v1.2.5
[*]Romanceable Rasmodia - tested with v1.6.3, awaiting content pack
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38994]Spouse Farmhouse [/url]Schedules - from v1.5
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5117]Immersive Spouses[/url]﻿
[*]Most dialogue expansions, including [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28046]Haley Ever After[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35854]Penny Ever After[/url]﻿.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Known Issues[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Multi-player.  Works on a basic level but you are likely to encounter bugs until it has more testing and development. 
[*]Android.
[/list][b]Incompatible Mods[/b][list]
[*]Mods that make it possible to walk through trellises
[*]Stardew Squad (reported on earlier versions, may be fixed)
[*]Yomi's Welfare Farmhouse (spouse can't find the door to go wandering)
[/list]
[size=5][b]To Do List[/b][/size]
Let me know what other features you would like to see for this mod in the comments. Things I would currently like to do include:
[list]
[*]Personalised dialogue for the remaining core game singles - just Maru to go, plus Krobus.
[*]More logic for selecting the order in which spouses walk around the farm
[*]Ability to go inside the farm buildings
[*]Ability for spouses to interact with the farm animals
[*]Interactions with other mods, like the ability for spouses to go swimming if the farmer builds [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35900]a swimming pool[/url]﻿.
[/list]
[size=5][b]Feedback[/b][/size]
This mod does hook fairly deeply into the game code, so please let me know if you encounter any issues running it. I think the worst of the bugs are fixed but there are probably still some bugs that have slipped through testing. I don't expect many compatibility issues, but let me know if you encounter any.
